calculation.expression: -rolling_sum(residual_log_return_5d,5)/rolling_mean(asset_volatility_20d,20), lagged_one_day, active iff benchmark_log_return_20d > 0 and residual_dispersion > trailing_120d_60th_percentile
calculation.description: Volatility-normalized short residual pullback, enabled only during a positive equal-weight benchmark trend and elevated cross-asset residual dispersion. Signal is lagged one trading day and inactive assets receive zero.

validation.regime_notes: 2024-2026: 24 dates IC 0.12038 ICIR 0.4621; 2027-2029: 132 dates IC 0.01762 ICIR 0.0618; 2030-2032: 166 dates IC 0.00738 ICIR 0.0741. Recent regimes are weaker and below standalone ICIR threshold, so monitor drift conservatively. Small 15-asset cross-section; IC estimates rely on many dates.
validation.method: Pearson cross-sectional daily IC; ICIR = mean daily IC / sample standard deviation daily IC; minimum 8 valid assets/date
